name: Igarashi Jun
source:
A simple MILF loving boy who has fallen in love with his classmate's mother. Even when his male friends in the same class are talking about girls in the class, gravure idols, etc.,  he shows no interest in those topics and only thinks about Keiko, the MILF teacher he is madly in love with.

After confessing his feelings to Keiko, he tries to tell her how serious he is about her, but she is always vague in her answers.  She is always reluctant to give her an answer, and his lust for her leads him to ask her to do something naughty.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=298745]Getchu[/url]]
